summary: Shoshone County, ID log cabin tower built 1935 for St. Joe National Forest; destroyed 1962; cement footings remain right off the road.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1962; cement footings remain at the site

events.note: Log cabin tower; all three history pages give 1935, and one credits Kresek
All three history pages give 1962 as the year it was destroyed
Idaho Fire Lookouts post dated September 4, 2025: footings found right off the road; one footing knocked out, apparently carried a plaque now unreadable

evidence.supports: Log cabin tower, built 1935, 1.25 miles northwest of Quarles Lookout, destroyed 1962
evidence.quote: 1935: log cabin tower 1.25 miles northwest of Quarles Lookout . Destroyed 1962.

evidence.supports: Built 1935 as a log cabin tower
Location, 13 miles east-northeast of Avery, Shoshone County
Elevation 5,600 feet; St. Joe National Forest
Agency, St. Joe National Forest; Shoshone County
Site is right off the road (drive_up)
evidence.quote: Crazily enough, the site of this lookout tower is RIGHT off the road – it seems like an odd place for a tower.

evidence.supports: Cement footings found; one knocked out; plaque now unreadable
evidence.quote: We quickly were able to find the cement footings and ONE of those footings was knocked out and appears to have had some sort of plaque on it. Its unreadable now.

notes_for_editor: Brief access 'unknown' stays unknown: the 2025 post says the site is right off the road, but no source gives access rules. No staffing history is documented, so no staffing fact. firelookout.com places the tower relative to Quarles Lookout; a Quarles record would help locate this site. Brief status 'gone' is supported.
